We need propose retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We need to output JSON route with type mol root, children reaction nodes etc. Need to select appropriate template IDs. We need to find templates matching each step: likely step1: amide formation (carboxylic acid to amide). In target, we have C(=O)N attached to an aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). So retrosynthesis: break amide to carboxylic acid and amine. So precursor: aromatic aldehyde? Actually amide from carboxylic acid + amine. So precursor1: acid: /C=C/C(=O) (the unsaturated acid) attached to phenyl sulfonyl phenyl? Wait structure: phenyl-sulfonyl-phenyl-CH=CH-CO-NH-Ph-NH2? Actually Nc3ccccc3N is an aniline with NH2 para? The SMILES: ...C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N. So amide carbonyl attached to an aniline (anilide) which also has an NH2 substituent (para? not specified). So retrosynthesis: break amide to acid (alpha,beta-unsaturated acid) and aniline (with NH2). So step1: amide formation.

Step2: The unsaturated acid could be formed via Doebner modification from aromatic aldehyde and malonic acid. So break double bond and carboxylate to aldehyde and malonic acid? Actually forward Doebner: aldehyde + malonic acid -> alpha,beta-unsaturated acid (cinnamic acid). So retrosynthesis: break C=C and carboxyl to aldehyde + malonic acid. So step2: break C=C and CO2H to aldehyde + malonic acid.

Step3: Sulfonamide formation: the sulfonamide linking phenyl-sulfonyl to aniline. So break S-N bond to sulfonyl chloride + amine? Actually forward sulfonamide formation: amine + sulfonyl chloride -> sulfonamide. So retrosynthesis: break sulfonamide to sulfonyl chloride (aryl sulfonyl chloride) and aniline (the phenyl with NH2). In target, the sulfonamide is attached to a phenyl ring (first phenyl with methyl). So we need sulfonyl chloride derived from that phenyl-sulfonyl group. So step3: break sulfonamide to sulfonyl chloride and aniline (the same aniline? Actually the sulfonamide nitrogen is attached to the phenyl ring (the first phenyl) and the sulfonyl group attached to second phenyl which also has the unsaturated acid side chain. So sulfonamide nitrogen is attached to first phenyl (with methyl). So the amine part is the aniline (first phenyl with methyl). So we need that aniline as precursor.

Thus overall precursors: 1) methyl phenyl amine (4-methyl aniline?) Actually SMILES: Cc1ccc(N... )cc1. That's p-toluidine (4-methyl aniline). So precursor: p-toluidine.

2) sulfonyl chloride derived from second phenyl with sulfonyl attached to unsaturated acid side chain? Actually sulfonyl chloride would be Ar-SO2Cl where Ar is the phenyl bearing the unsaturated acid side chain (c2ccc(... )cc2). So we need that phenyl with side chain unsaturated acid (cinnamic acid derivative). So precursor: that phenyl with side chain unsaturated acid (cinnamic acid) and a sulfonyl chloride group? Wait the sulfonyl chloride is the electrophile; the side chain is attached to the phenyl ring via the sulfonyl group? Actually target: NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2. So sulfonamide nitrogen attached to sulfonyl group attached to phenyl ring which also has the unsaturated amide side chain. So the sulfonyl chloride precursor would be the phenyl ring with sulfonyl chloride (SO2Cl) attached, and also the side chain unsaturated acid? The side chain is attached to the phenyl ring via a carbon (aryl-CH=CH-CO-NH-Ph-NH2). So the sulfonyl chloride precursor would be the same phenyl ring bearing both the sulfonyl chloride and the side chain? Actually the sulfonyl chloride is attached to the phenyl ring, not the side chain. So we need a phenyl sulfonyl chloride (Ar-SO2Cl) where Ar is the phenyl bearing the side chain (cinnamoyl anilide). So that precursor is a phenyl sulfonyl chloride with the side chain attached.

Thus step3: sulfonamide formation between p-toluidine and that sulfonyl chloride.

Step2: Doebner modification to make the side chain unsaturated acid attached to phenyl. The side chain is attached to phenyl via a vinyl group: /C=C/C(=O)N... So the unsaturated acid is attached to phenyl via the double bond. So the precursor for step2 is the aldehyde (aryl-CHO) attached to phenyl (the same phenyl) and malonic acid. So the aldehyde is the phenyl-CHO (c2ccc(C=O)cc2) where the aldehyde is para to the sulfonyl group? Actually the side chain attaches at position where the aldehyde would be. So we need phenyl aldehyde (c2ccc(C=O)cc2) with sulfonyl chloride? Wait the sulfonyl chloride is attached to the phenyl ring; the aldehyde is also attached to same ring at a different position. So the precursor for step2 is the same phenyl ring bearing sulfonyl chloride and aldehyde group (i.e., 4-formyl phenyl sulfonyl chloride). That seems plausible.

Thus overall route:

Target -> step1 (amide formation) break amide: gives unsaturated acid (cinnamic acid attached to phenyl-sulfonyl) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). Actually the amide nitrogen is attached to aniline (c3ccccc3N). So the amine precursor is aniline with NH2 (maybe para-? but just aniline). So step1 precursors: unsaturated acid (aryl-CH=CH-COOH) attached to phenyl-sulfonyl chloride? Wait the acid is attached to phenyl-sulfonyl? The unsaturated acid is attached to phenyl-sulfonyl via the double bond. So the acid precursor is the same phenyl-sulfonyl phenyl with unsaturated acid (cinnamic acid). So we keep that.

Step2: Doebner modification: unsaturated acid derived from aldehyde + malonic acid. So precursors: aldehyde (aryl-CHO) with sulfonyl chloride, and malonic acid.

Step3: Sulfonamide formation: aldehyde-sulfonyl chloride + p-toluidine -> sulfonamide (aryl-sulfonyl chloride + aniline). Wait the sulfonyl chloride reacts with p-toluidine to give sulfonamide (the first phenyl). So step3 precursors: p-toluidine and aryl-sulfonyl chloride (which also has aldehyde). So final set of starting materials: p-toluidine, malonic acid, and maybe the aldehyde? Actually aldehyde is generated from step2, not starting. So starting materials: p-toluidine, malonic acid, and the aldehyde (aryl-CHO with sulfonyl chloride). But the aldehyde is also derived from something? Could be from a commercially available aryl aldehyde (e.g., 4-formyl phenyl sulfonyl chloride). That may be available.

Thus we need to construct JSON with three reaction nodes in sequence.

We need template IDs. We don't know IDs; we can search using search_template_catalog_by_criteria. Let's search for amide formation: functional_groups_broken: ["carboxylic_acid"], functional_groups_formed: ["amide"] maybe.
